scope: Earlier original annual observations for the seven restored EU candidates. Original eight-name coverage is supplied separately.
eligibility_note: Siemens Energy first listed September 28 2020. Its prospectus was available September 7. Under a strict first-of-month information cutoff it first enters October 2020; no artificial pre-listing score is required.
boundary_qualification: Earliest recovered complete annual observations, not proof that earlier original filings cannot be recovered. Alfen FY2017 IPO prospectus and original FY2017 accounts for the other then-listed candidates would be needed to test earlier starts.
method_notes: All five financial fields are in millions of each reporting currency; no currency conversion is needed for the dimensionless score ratios.
No later comparative financial values are backdated. Nel FY2018 original CFO and current liabilities differ from its FY2019 comparative figures and use the original 2018 report.
Orsted uses IFRS EBIT/net profit, not its business-performance adjustment columns.

Safran uses statutory consolidated accounts, not adjusted results. Earlier 2018/2019 results-day attachments were not recovered; exact annual-document publication dates are used conservatively and recorded explicitly.
Pre-2020 observations are annual. Additional original interim statements could improve signal granularity, but no quarterly figures are invented.
No predecessor Siemens price or financial history is used for pre-listing Siemens Energy.
